description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of frames and accuracy for different models. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Frames" and has a linear scale ranging from 10 to 50, with tick labels at intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and has a linear scale ranging from 40 to 54, with tick labels at intervals of 2. 

The line representing "Ours (Dynamic 4-Seg)" is blue with circular markers and a dashed line style. It begins at approximately 52.4% accuracy at 10 frames and remains relatively stable, ending at approximately 52.6% accuracy at 50 frames. The line representing "Ours (Static 4-Seg)" is green with circular markers and a solid line style. It starts at approximately 52.7% accuracy at 10 frames and also remains relatively stable, ending at approximately 52.8% accuracy at 50 frames. The line representing "PLLaVA (DP 16)" is red with square markers and a dashed line style. It begins at approximately 44.4% accuracy at 10 frames and declines to approximately 41.2% accuracy at 50 frames. The line representing "LLaVA (DP 16)" is orange with square markers and a solid line style. It starts at approximately 44.4% accuracy at 10 frames and declines to approximately 40.2% accuracy at 50 frames.
